culture.text: A marine technology company focused on decarbonising shipping; staff call themselves 'Wärtsilians'.
A Finnish industrial group headquartered in Helsinki, founded in 1834, with about 18,000 employees.

open.text: Wärtsilä Netherlands is an IND recognised visa sponsor.
